long_biography.plain_text:
Leonhardt started CrossCountry Mortgage in a single Cleveland-area branch, bringing in a small team that included relatives and friends. Rather than retreat during the mortgage crisis, he pursued growth, expanded the branch network and built a national retail lender. The company combined home-loan origination with an increasingly large servicing operation and asset-management capabilities.

In 2026, CrossCountry completed its acquisition of Two Harbors Investment Corp., including RoundPoint Mortgage Servicing. The transaction extended Leonhardt's platform across more of the mortgage lifecycle, from originating loans to managing servicing assets and borrower relationships. He remains founder and chief executive, with an operating role spanning strategy, acquisitions and the expansion of a privately controlled financial-services group.

uncertainties.detail: The authoritative input links person 7069 to the 40-metre Tasty Waves from May 2022. The Bahamas Department of Inland Revenue independently associates Tasty Waves with RL Junior LLC, and Florida's official register names Ronald Leonhardt Jr. as that entity's manager at CrossCountry's Cleveland address. Independent yacht data matches the exact 40.08-metre, 299-GT Riva. This creates a strong vessel-entity-person chain without relying on initials alone.

The upstream owner record gives 1947, but no reviewed strong identity, corporate, media or transaction source corroborates that year. Because that source is insufficient for an importable correction, no birth day, month or year change is proposed; the existing 1947 value should receive human review and is omitted from both biographies.

An Ohio appellate opinion expressly describes Leonhardt as CrossCountry's owner and chief executive, while first-party and independent sources establish founder and continuing CEO status. The precise current personal ownership percentage and holding-company structure are not disclosed here, so the dossier uses founder ownership without claiming sole ownership or a quantified stake.

The first branch, small founding team and prior mortgage-broker work support Self-made — independent start. The reviewed sources do not disclose the initial financing, personal savings, loans or outside capital. The classification therefore means no inherited operating platform or family-controlled enterprise is evidenced, not that every dollar of startup capital was independently earned.

The transaction completed on 25 August 2026, making Two Harbors a wholly owned subsidiary of CrossCountry's intermediate holding company and Leonhardt a director. The biographies use this only as a durable integration milestone and omit transaction price, financing, preferred-stock redemptions and other short-lived deal mechanics.

Leonhardt is also linked to Cleveland real estate, hospitality and other private ventures, but comparable current ownership and valuation evidence is incomplete. CrossCountry's documented founder ownership and national scale make mortgage finance the strongest identifiable wealth-creation and primary industry without asserting that it is his only asset.

No proposal-grade Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok, Wikipedia or personal website was found; CrossCountry's About page is proposed only as a Company Website.
